text: Why ChooseQiqihar Medical University 1. Reputed University. Qiqihar Medical University has a glorious history of 65 years behind it. Founded in 1946, Qiqihar Medical University has grown from strength to strength in the last six decades and today it is one of the most reputed universities in China. Qiqihar Medical University also has several exchange programs with reputed universities in Asia, Europe and America 2. Nominal Fees. The fees are extremely affordable at Qiqihar Medical University. 3. Excellent Infrastructure. The equipment and infrastructure of all the affiliated hospitals is as state of the art as it is utilitarian. 4. Free Chinese Language Classes. Qiqihar also provides Free Chinese language classes to first year students to ease the transition into a different culture. In addition, the University also provides clinical Chinese classes free to third year students to lower the linguistic difficulties while engaged in clinical practice.
